'''Komle''', also called '''raspeball''', is a Norwegian dish of potato dumplings, often eaten along with sausages, boiled carrots and bacon.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled
* 100 g [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 20 g (about 3–4 tsp) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 150 g [[Cookbook:Pork|salted pork]]
* Lightly-salted beef [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the potatoes in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]. 
# Squeeze the potato mass to discard the water.
# Mix the potatoes with the flour, and let the [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] rest for 10 minutes.
# Shape the dough into big round balls, and fill them with pieces of the salted pork.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the balls in beef stock for about 15–20 minutes.
